steps.name: saved_ack_lost
steps.meaning: Actual raw weak cycles reached research review; service committed while device still has pending records.

steps.name: phone_unreachable
steps.meaning: Simulated push accepted; receiver and read confirmations are absent.

steps.name: service_receiver_reopened
steps.meaning: Persisted retry succeeds; one research notice exists.

steps.name: tick_duplicate_and_read
steps.meaning: Tick retains original evidence time and silently refreshes the same episode; read is explicit simulation.

steps.name: clip_and_late_push
steps.meaning: Old saved card invalidates and late hint is rejected.

steps.name: offline_batch_change
steps.meaning: New batch snapshot fences accumulated research-review event before push.

steps.name: device_restart
steps.meaning: New persistent boot and empty evidence cancel pre-restart pending review.

steps.name: required_not_applied
steps.meaning: Required config changed but device still reports old actually applied config.

steps.name: new_config_new_evidence
steps.meaning: Actual configure, reinstallation and fresh raw cycles create a new research-domain notice.

steps.name: rebind_and_fresh_review
steps.meaning: New owner only receives a newly stabilized and measured research episode.

steps.name: unreachable_until_expiry
steps.meaning: Exact evidence-anchored expiry cancels pending review without an extra alert.
